properties.name: A project's first session leaves the adapter in place: no instruction file means run the init when the kit is present, otherwise write the served pointer and register it
properties.statement: On genesis or adopt of a project with no instruction file an agent reads first: run `reflow2 init .` when ~/.local/share/reflow2/kit exists (pointer + hooks + MCP config); otherwise get_instructions {section: pointer} and write it as AGENTS.md, or REFLOW2.md when the project owns an AGENTS.md; then register the file as the adapter (add_artifact document, documents doc_kind agent_instructions). Never have the server write it. Why: three of the owner's projects had none on 2026-09-19 — the user-scope route installs nothing, the session hooks then never fire, and agent_instructions_unregistered fires on the design.
